besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects and verbs (die verlede is / ons kan).
besluite.rede: Two full sentences joined by 'en' take the AWS comma, and nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects and verbs ('n ou foto bly / 'n ou pot bly).
besluite.rede: Two full sentences joined by 'en' take the AWS comma, and nothing else changes.

This is not a simple list: the comma separates the second 'en' from the nested 'visuele, mondelinge en geskrewe leidrade', which shows the reader there are four groups; without it, 'geskrewe' can seem to modify 'voorwerpbronne' as well and a child may count three.

besluite.fout: 'vanuit' is stiff here, a loose copy of English 'from'; Afrikaans uses plain 'uit' for getting information out of sources.
besluite.rede: 'uit bronne' means exactly the same (information taken from sources) and is the natural Grade 4 wording, though if this sentence is a decided shared definition the guard will refuse it and send it to the writer.
